findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "claude" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: import_address_list · Public sink: import_address_list, quote_mailing, get_mailing_status · Destructive: import_address_list, fix_address.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: import_address_list · Public sink: import_address_list, quote_mailing, get_mailing_status · Destructive: import_address_list, fix_address

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
